newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: RBNZ's MPS prepared before NZ govt formed.
newsitem.headline: RBNZ's MPS prepared before NZ govt formed.

text.p: The Reserve Bank of New Zealand finalised its six-monthly monetary policy statement before the new coalition government was formed last week, a spokesman for the bank said on Monday.
The MPS will be released on Tuesday.
As usual, there will be an accompanying press statement on monetary conditions. The press statement is not finalised until after 8.00 a.m. (1900 GMT) on the day of the MPS.

As well, bank Governor Don Brash will conduct a news conference at around 8.30 a.m. (1930 GMT), where he is expected to make comment on the new Policy Target Agreement signed with the new government, the new 0-3 percent inflation target and possibly comments on the government's new budget targets as they pertain to monetary policy.
Information from the news conference and the MPS will be released at 9.00 a.m. (2000 GMT).
